class.name: CgameSnapshotDelta
class.brief_description: Computes and applies baseline deltas between snapshots of entity dictionaries.
class.description: A snapshot is a [Dictionary] mapping an entity id (int) to a [Dictionary] of field name to value. [method diff] produces a delta with these keys: - [code]changed[/code]: [code]{id: {field: value}}[/code] with only the fields that differ from the baseline. - [code]added[/code]: [code]{id: entity}[/code] for entities absent from the baseline. - [code]removed[/code]: [PackedInt64Array] of entity ids gone since the baseline. - [code]dropped[/code]: [code]{id: Array}[/code] of field names deleted from a kept entity. Present only when non-empty. Values are deep-copied, so neither the baseline nor the delta alias the result of [method apply]. All methods are static. [codeblock] var delta := CgameSnapshotDelta.diff(last_acked, current, {"pos": 0.01}) var rebuilt := CgameSnapshotDelta.apply(last_acked, delta) [/codeblock]

method.name: apply
method.description: Returns a new snapshot made by applying [param delta] to [param baseline]. The baseline is not modified. Changes for entities that do not exist are ignored.

method.name: diff
method.description: Returns the delta that turns [param baseline] into [param current]. [param tolerances] maps a field name to a float epsilon; [float], [Vector2] and [Vector3] values within the epsilon of the baseline are not resent. Values of different types always count as changed.

method.name: is_empty
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param delta] contains no changes.
